title: Butter bean fattoush salad
summary: Butter bean fattoush salad is a middle eastern dinner built around canned butter beans and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook canned butter beans for Butter bean fattoush salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cherry tomatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss cucumber with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Butter bean fattoush salad straight away. Taste Butter bean fattoush salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the pittas, simmered in salted water until tender.
